population: Harappa seal families from Mound F with a Vats stratum in the Lipi export (175 families), one legend each; frames are Vats's trench cells with at least 15 seals (others pooled, pools under 5 dropped); u is the mid-rank of the stratum over the mound's seals in frames, scaled to (0, 1), 0 oldest (Stratum VII) and 1 latest (Stratum I); early third u < 1/3 (Strata VII-V, HARP 3B-1 and 3B/C), late third u >= 2/3 (Strata II-I, 3C-3 and 3C-4). Positions read at surviving edges of single-line legends (period_stats.edge_text_fields); identical complete legends in a frame merged at median u. Both halves of the package's bench shots split are read after the freeze and pooled.
frozen_parameters: discovery-v2/frozen-parameters.json: closing stock (15 signs, union of the DK-G and Harappa pool stocks), equivalence margin 0.25, fail size 0.15, early-share threshold 0.55, category minimum 5, inventory minimum 8, credence effects

predictions.statistic: Share of legends (closing sign read, not a complete one-sign legend) that close in the closing stock, late third minus early third
predictions.null: Equivalence: 90% percentile interval from 9,999 bootstrap resamples within frames; fail side: two-sided permutation p from 9,999 permutations of u within frames
predictions.pass_rule: pass if the 90% interval lies inside (-0.25, 0.25) and stays inside after deleting, one at a time, each of the ten legends whose deletion moves the estimate most (1,999 resamples each); fail if the permutation p is at most 0.05 and the estimate is at least 0.15 in absolute value, and each of the ten deletions that move the estimate most toward zero leaves p at most 0.10; otherwise inconclusive
predictions.credence_effect: pass +0.05; inconclusive -0.02; fail -0.10, and a fail whose Holm-adjusted p over P1 and P3-P7 is at most 0.05 kills the card

predictions.statistic: Share of early-third legends that close in the closing stock
predictions.pass_rule: At least 0.55, also after deleting one early-third legend that closes in the stock
predictions.credence_effect: pass +0.02; fail -0.06 (level not fresh: corpus-wide closing structure is spent)

predictions.statistic: Rank analysis of variance of u across opening-sign categories (signs opening at least 5 units, the rest pooled): n times the between-category share of the variance of u
predictions.null: 9,999 permutations of u among units within frames
predictions.pass_rule: drift if one-sided p <= 0.05 and each of the ten units whose deletion lowers the statistic most, deleted alone, leaves p <= 0.10 (2,999 permutations); no drift if p > 0.10; otherwise inconclusive. The prediction is no drift
predictions.credence_effect: no drift +0.05; inconclusive -0.03; drift -0.10, and a drift whose Holm-adjusted p over P1 and P3-P7 is at most 0.05 kills the card

predictions.statistic: Variant choice: sum over Mayig variant classes of the between-variant rank statistic minus its degrees of freedom (Wells codes mapped to one class; classes with at least two codes of 3 or more tokens and 10 rows; one row per legend and class); all legends, identical complete legends merged
predictions.credence_effect: no drift +0.02; inconclusive -0.02; drift -0.08, kill as P3

predictions.statistic: Correlation between the within-frame rank of legend length and u, complete legends
predictions.null: 9,999 permutations of u within frames, two-sided
predictions.pass_rule: As P3 with a two-sided p; the influence rule deletes the units that move the correlation most toward zero
predictions.credence_effect: no drift +0.02; inconclusive -0.02; drift -0.08, kill as P3

predictions.statistic: Sign inventory: for every sign present in at least 8 legends, its number of legends times the squared deviation of their mean u from the overall mean, summed and divided by the variance of u; all legends, identical complete legends merged
predictions.credence_effect: no drift +0.02; inconclusive -0.02; drift -0.08, kill as P3

predictions.statistic: Rank analysis of variance of u across closing-sign categories (signs closing at least 5 units, the rest pooled)
predictions.credence_effect: no drift +0.04; inconclusive -0.03; drift -0.10, kill as P3

predictions.statistic: Positive control: Pearson correlation between u and an indicator of a rectangular seal (SEAL:R), every seal in frames
predictions.credence_effect: none directly; when PC fails, the P1 pass and every 'no drift' outcome add half their gain

joint_credence_rule: C-0010 credence after the test = 0.40 + the effects of P1-P7; when the positive control PC fails, positive effects of P1 and P3-P7 count at half weight. The card is dead, at 0.02, if P1 fails or any of P3-P7 shows drift with a Holm-adjusted p (over the P1 permutation p and the p-values of P3-P7) at most 0.05. Otherwise the result is held within [0.02, 0.90]; status strengthened if above 0.40, weakened otherwise.
influence_rule: Every pass of P1, fail of P1 and drift of P3-P7 requires its single-deletion check; leave-one-frame-out results are reported for drifts without changing an outcome.
sensitivity: Reported, not deciding: permutation over the whole mound instead of within trenches; Vats's printed depth ranked within trenches as the clock; the DK-G stock alone for P1 and P2; complete legends only for P1, P2, P3 and P7; each loader half scored separately with 1,999 draws; a descriptive table by third.
